paragraphs.intro: For 23 years I have been training engineers at the National University of Mar del Plata, in Computer Engineering and Electronics programs.
paragraphs.legacy: My journey in systems development began in 1993 working with COBOL and indexed files in administrative accounting systems. This early experience with legacy technologies gave me a deep understanding of the challenges companies face when modernizing critical infrastructures.
paragraphs.approach: This academic experience, combined with continuous work on industrial projects, has allowed me to develop a unique perspective that bridges methodological rigor with practical application.
paragraphs.leadership: I have led multidisciplinary teams on critical infrastructure projects, where systematic planning and risk management are fundamental to success.
paragraphs.expertise: My specialization focuses on legacy systems modernization and embedded firmware development, especially in environments where operational continuity is critical.
paragraphs.conclusion: The methodological approach that characterizes my work is reflected in every project:
paragraphs.value: robust solutions that address complexity from a comprehensive and sustainable perspective.
